grading_method.policy: grading-policy.md, applied to all 63 complete current reader objects independently
grading_method.unit_of_assessment: Only the same-local answer and evidence; support/confidence labels are not grades. No cross-answer borrowing.
grading_method.scope: Literal frozen question requests, predetermined unchanged key, frozen summary support, and supplied primary PDF/extracted text. Unasked key context is not required unless answer asserts a conflicting universal rule.
grading_method.equivalence: Natural entailment and unambiguous operations defined in summary accepted; explicit requested costs, destinations, timings and exceptions still required. Variable costs may refer to exposed boxes.

grade_definitions.correct: Every requested material part resolved, no material source contradiction or unsupported guess.
grade_definitions.partial: Requested material omission or unresolved part without contradictory ruling, including explicit abstention.
grade_definitions.incorrect: Material contradictory ruling, irrespective of other correct parts.

grading_method.unsupported_guess_handling: Correct-in-source claims absent from frozen summary would be separately flagged and would not count correct. No such lucky unsupported claim was identified in this reader. Q44 is a substantive contradiction, not a correct-but-unsupported guess.
grading_method.primary_source_inspection: Read extracted source text and inspected supplied PDF via pypdf text extraction, including p.6 seating, p.19 structure qualification, pp.21–29 faction/combat/encounter/Factory/objective/star/scoring rules.
grading_method.exclusions: No previous grades, reader trials, audit conclusions, other-reader outputs, web or other game evidence consulted; no input repaired.
